verdict.rationale: Kimi is an agentic assistant with a CLI, desktop app and editor integrations, so MCP-client support is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the evidence mentions MCP. The closest items are Kimi's own plugin/skill system (kimi-docs-13) and the ACP protocol for editors (kimi-docs-5); both are adjacent features, not documented support for plugging in MCP servers, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
